says: No law reads the error `reason` span tag on access.write. Removing its `Effect.tapError(... annotateCurrentSpan(tag("reason"), error.reason))` fails nothing, on main (ClientManager.ts:216) as on ticket 731's branch, where the line now sits in ClientManagerLedger.ts:183. The same annotation on access.read is covered.
proof: Deleted line 183 of access/ClientManagerLedger.ts (the access.write reason tapError). `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1` printed `Tests 14 passed (14)` for access/AccessSpans.test.ts, `Tests 11 passed (11)` for runtime/EffectFunctions.test.ts and `Tests 20 passed (20)` for access/ClientManager.test.ts. Control: deleting the access.read reason tapError (line 190) made AccessSpans.test.ts print `Tests 1 failed | 13 passed (14)`. File restored by copy after each plant.
cost: A failed membership write can lose its error reason in telemetry with every check green, so a person reading the span cannot tell why the write failed.
